imageMosaic.title: Image Mosaic/Blur
imageMosaic.description: Hide faces, license plates, names and addresses with mosaic, blur or a solid box. Paste screenshots with Ctrl+V. Nothing is uploaded.

safety.title: Hiding things for real
items: Cover text (names, phone numbers, addresses, account numbers, plates) with a black or white box. Only a solid box leaves none of the original pixels.
Small-block mosaic or light blur keeps the shape of letters and can sometimes be reconstructed. If you use them, turn the size/strength up.
The saved file is a brand-new image with only the redacted result. Undo history and the original are not included.
Before posting, zoom to 100% and check the edges are fully covered.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Take a screenshot and press Ctrl+V, drop an image, or choose a file.
Draw what to hide with the rectangle, ellipse or brush tool. Add as many regions as you need.
Pick an effect (mosaic, blur, black or white box) and strength. With a region selected, only that region changes.
Move or resize regions with the Select tool and delete them from the list. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z to undo/redo.
Download as PNG/JPG or copy to the clipboard and paste it straight into a chat or post.

tips.title: Tips
items: Zoom with Ctrl+wheel or two fingers for detailed work on large photos.
PNG suits screenshots; JPG keeps photos smaller.
Auto face detection appears only in browsers that support it. Always check for missed faces.
Press Delete to remove the selected region and Esc to deselect.

whatIs.title: What is the Photo Mosaic/Blur Tool?
whatIs.description: The Photo Mosaic/Blur tool is a browser-based image editor that applies mosaic pixelation or Gaussian blur to specific areas of a photo to obscure personal information or sensitive content. You can define rectangular regions with a selection tool or paint freely over areas using a brush. No images are sent to any server.

items.q: Is my image uploaded to a server?
items.a: No. Loading, editing and saving all happen inside your browser; the image is never sent anywhere.
With small blocks or weak blur, there are techniques that can guess the text. A solid box is the safest choice for text.

items.q: Is the photo's GPS location removed?
items.a: Yes. Saving or copying re-encodes only the pixels, so EXIF GPS, camera and date data are not in the result.

items.q: Can I edit a region after drawing it?
items.a: Use the Select tool to move or resize it; while selected you can change its effect and strength or delete it. Ctrl+Z undoes.
